name: Ghost
line: Publish a website and send newsletters with managed hosting or your own server.

free.text: Free MIT software; you run a server and connect Mailgun for bulk email

cells.api: Yes; hosted Admin API on Publisher+

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers: 4,000 bulk emails plus an assumed 1,000 system emails. $12 server (DigitalOcean 2GB), $2.40 backup, and $35 Mailgun Foundation plan for 50,000 emails, before extras and tax.
5,000 subscribers: 20,000 bulk emails plus an assumed 1,000 system emails. $12 server (DigitalOcean 2GB), $2.40 backup, and $35 Mailgun Foundation plan for 50,000 emails, before extras and tax.
10,000 subscribers: 40,000 bulk emails plus an assumed 1,000 system emails. $12 server (DigitalOcean 2GB), $2.40 backup, and $35 Mailgun Foundation plan for 50,000 emails, before extras and tax.

50,000 subscribers: 200,000 bulk emails plus an assumed 1,000 system emails. $12 server, $2.40 backup, and $90 Mailgun Scale plan, plus 101,000 extra emails at $1.10 per 1,000 if that rate applies. This is not exact.
